\documentclass{article}
\title{Baseline Sequence Encoder}
\date{2017}
\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
We present a baseline encoder for sequence transduction tasks.
\end{abstract}

\section{Model}
The encoder stacks identical layers, each with self-attention and a
feed-forward network. We use 6 layers throughout.

\section{Training Setup}
We train with the Adam optimizer using a learning rate of 0.0001 for the base
model. We apply a dropout rate of 0.1 to the output of each sub-layer. Training
uses a batch size of 128 sequences.

\end{document}
